title: froelichia nudicaulis subsp. longispicata
intro: Froelichia nudicaulis subsp. longispicata, commonly known as Long-spined Desert-holly, is a subspecies of the Froelichia nudicaulis plant, a type of succulent native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Long-spined Desert-holly include its use as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic, potentially relieving symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
